interpretation_boundary: Measurements apply only to this installed Waves Smack Attack VST3 Stereo instance, A: Default Preset, Guard Off, Output 0.0, the visible default detector/shape/duration/mix states, and the rendered 48 kHz fixture. The fixture was auto-warped by Ableton from 11.25 s to 12 s; all windows reference the rendered control. Attack +100 and Sustain -100 were tested as separate single-variable extremes. The test establishes envelope direction and magnitude on this synthetic stepped-tone/transient fixture, not speech-phoneme detection accuracy, perceived vocal quality, or a universal time constant. It does not establish other shapes, durations, sensitivities, Mix positions, Guard modes, stereo unlink behavior, mono, other formats/sample rates/versions, automation, CPU, or blind-listening preference.
